description: Standard biped mobs share the player's 8x8x8 head and arm geometry with different textures. Zombie arms are rotated forward but the shoulder bone origin is unchanged.

mob_specific_notes.zombie: Arms are pre-rotated ~90 degrees forward (pose, not pivot). Gestures must account for the zombie-arms resting pose or use Off.
mob_specific_notes.skeleton: Arms hold a bow. Gestures may conflict with held-item animations.
mob_specific_notes.wither_skeleton: Same head size but 2.4 block tall. Mouth placement is identical relative to head bone.

notes: Same head geometry as the player. Mouth placement is identical. Arm gestures need a per-mob resting-pose offset for zombies.
